seq.d: OAuth 2.0 client credentials against Cisco's identity service. The Client ID and Secret come from your app in the API Console.
Cache it. The default lifetime is 3,600 seconds; renew a few minutes early instead of logging in per call.
One PID per call, with the current release and the target (latest, above, or a specific release). Use /metadata/pidimage instead when you know the exact file names.
Keep four things: metadataTransId (valid 60 minutes), mdfId, imageGuid and sha512. Check exception[] on each image: a 200 can still carry a blocking code.

seq.t: Clear a license gate, only if asked
seq.d: EULA_FORM_AR, K9_FORM_AR or K9_IMG_DWLD mean an agreement is open. Read it with GET, and have the accountable person accept it. These are legal attestations.
Up to five GUIDs for the same PID and MDF ID, with a metadataTransId that is still live.
Each downloads[] entry has a sessionalized url (60 minutes), a token (set only for Cisco's cloud store) and its own exception[]. No checksum here.
Empty token: append your API access token to the URL. Token set: form-POST it as X-Authentication-Control. Keep certificate checks on.
seq.c:
curl -fL -o "$IMAGE" "$URL&access_token=$TOKEN"
# or, cloud store
curl -fL -o "$IMAGE" -X POST "$URL" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  --data-urlencode "X-Authentication-Control=$CLOUD_TOKEN"

seq.d: Cisco documents one or more HTTP 302 Found redirects before the final URL. curl -L and requests both follow them.
seq.c:
302 Found  -> Location: …
302 Found  -> Location: …
200 OK     (image bytes)

seq.d: Compare SHA-512 with the value from the metadata call. On mismatch, delete the file and start again from metadata.

repo: Software Suggestion v2 to choose the release, ASD /metadata/pidrelease and /download/pidimage to fetch it, SHA-512 check, then your repository. Catch: entitlement (SNTC or PSS, contracts on the automation identity's profile) and the 60-minute window.
catc: POST /dna/intent/api/v1/images/ccoSync, list with GET /images?imported=false, then POST /images/{id}/download; upgrade with the networkDeviceImages family (2.3.7.9 and later). Catch: ccoSync is rate limited, and the older /image/distribution and /image/activation/device are Sunset from 3.1.3.
ucs: Use the Intersight software repository (firmware/Distributables) and POST /api/v1/firmware/Upgrades for servers; fabric-interconnect upgrades in Intersight Managed Mode. Catch: the scope is UCS servers and fabric interconnects, not Nexus switches.
pick: GET /software/suggestion/v2/suggestions/releases/productIds/{pids}, or /compatible/productId/{pid}?currentRelease=… for an upgrade path. Catch: results can be empty or off for retired or some newer PIDs; cross-check release notes and field notices.
audit: POST up to five file names from your inventory to /software/v4.0/metadata/images for release date, isDeleted, size, MD5 and SHA-512. Catch: no metadataTransId, so this call cannot lead to a download.
